summary:
Adobe EPS 5.96 美元小幅超預期，營收年增12.7%，AI 創作工具持續推升訂閱，本益比僅約12倍偏低。
• EPS 5.96 美元，超預期 2.50%，獲利穩定成長
• 營收 66.2 億美元，年增 12.69%，訂閱模式韌性強
• Firefly 等生成式 AI 功能帶動 Creative Cloud 升級
• 本益比約 11.92 倍，相對軟體同業估值偏低
ai_view:
訊號正向：營收與獲利雙超預期且維持雙位數成長，顯示 AI 創作功能有效強化訂閱黏著度，而約12倍本益比已大幅反映市場對 AI 顛覆的疑慮，估值具防禦性。短期股價或受 AI 變現指引主導；中期需追蹤 Digital Media ARR 成長、Firefly 付費滲透率與淨新增訂閱，若 AI 帶來加值定價，估值有重估空間。

需留意：市場擔憂生成式 AI 新創（如 Midjourney）對核心創作業務的長期衝擊；成熟市場滲透率高，營收成長空間趨緩；AI 變現節奏若不如預期將壓抑估值重估

summary_en:
Adobe beat EPS at $5.96 with 12.7% revenue growth as AI creative tools lifted subscriptions, while a ~12x P/E looks undemanding.
• EPS of $5.96 beat by 2.50% with stable earnings growth
• Revenue of $6.62B grew 12.69%, showing subscription resilience
• Generative AI features like Firefly drive Creative Cloud upgrades
• P/E of ~11.92x is low relative to software peers

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: revenue and earnings both beat with double-digit growth, suggesting AI creative features reinforce subscription stickiness, while a ~12x P/E already reflects disruption fears, lending valuation support. Near term the stock will hinge on AI monetization guidance; mid term, track Digital Media ARR growth, Firefly paid adoption and net-new subscriptions. If AI enables premium pricing, there is room for re-rating.

Watch：Concern over long-term disruption from genAI startups like Midjourney; High penetration in mature markets caps revenue upside; Slower-than-expected AI monetization could weigh on re-rating
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 2.50%、營收年增 12.69%，穩健達標。
